Indian regulator continues probe into Hindenburg, Adani case

India's market regulator is continuing its investigation into allegations made by Hindenburg Research and other parties concerning the Adani Group. Sources indicate the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) is proceeding with its examination of the case. The regulator is reportedly looking into various aspects related to the allegations, with the investigation ongoing.
